limits: Original Bingo CGI camera and lighting were not recovered; camera was calibrated to each original90 guide.
Real native model clips and UVs, exact x4 pack textures; reconstructed Blender lighting/shader can differ from retail CGI gloss.
Backgrounds are new procedural reconstructions, not identified original arenas or claimed pack scene donors.
Generic frames and clipping aperture are analytic vector reconstructions, not enlarged native bitmap or Pokemon silhouettes.
Importer omits zero-area primitives and uses white for absent vertex colors; no claim of bit-exact retail fixed-function shading.
Native90 here denotes a real source-material DCC model render, not the original composed Bingo bitmap.
This art approval is distinct from a Dolphin menu runtime witness. GPU PNG bytes may vary across graphics drivers.
